us.name_en: United States - annual CO2 emissions of the electric power sector (EIA; total, million metric tons)
us.attribution_en: Source: U.S. EIA, State Energy Data System (SEDS), series TEEIE (electric power sector CO2) and CDTCR, retrieved 2026-09-04. Published values as-is; units as published.
us.note: Retrieved 2026-09-04 via the EIA API v2 seds route with the site's key (read-only): TEEIE US 2024 = 1,421.714 million metric tons CO2 (2023: 1,415.175; 2022: 1,532.04). This is a total (not per kWh); the per-kWh intensity of the U.S. grid (EPA eGRID) remains a separate ledger candidate. SEDS terms: EIA data are public domain.
us.source_series: SEDS seriesId TEEIE (Total energy CO2 emissions for the electric power sector), stateId US

intensity_reference.series: CDTCR Carbon intensity of energy supply (CO2 emissions divided by total energy consumption less interstate flow of electricity)
intensity_reference.unit: metric tons CO2 per billion Btu

conventions.definition: doc/version/fixed_on of the frozen indicator definition; null with a note when no versioned definition exists
conventions.attribution: Attribute original content as "AI Lifeline"; keep upstream source names on every value
conventions.status: ok / watch / alert only where a frozen machine rule exists (Japan power chapter); "observing" = collected, not judged; do not infer thresholds
conventions.value_status: final = settled; provisional = may still change (same-day or incomplete observation); provisional=true mirrors it
conventions.backfilled: true = retrieved retrospectively after the series went live (kept apart from day-by-day observation)

_note: AI Lifeline - one-file world summary (added 2026-09-03). Aggregates the latest confirmed value of every published series in every edition, with observation date, status, provisional/backfilled flags and the version of the indicator definition. Regenerated after each edition's daily batch; regions[].last_updated is per edition, generated_at is the whole file.
